title: Quark Optimized
description: Changing what can be done in Minecraft.
body:
# Quark Optimized

Quark Optimized is a lightweight performance-focused Minecraft modpack designed to improve server and client performance while maintaining a near-vanilla gameplay experience.

The pack combines a carefully selected collection of optimization mods that reduce lag, improve chunk loading, increase server efficiency, and provide smoother gameplay without changing Minecraft's core mechanics. It is suitable for survival worlds, multiplayer servers, technical gameplay, and long-term worlds where stability and performance are important.

### Features

* Improved FPS and client performance
* Faster chunk generation and loading
* Reduced server lag and better TPS stability
* Memory and CPU usage optimizations
* Enhanced networking performance
* Vanilla-friendly experience
* Compatible with large survival and multiplayer worlds

### Goals

Quark Optimized aims to provide the best possible Minecraft performance while preserving the feel of vanilla gameplay. Every mod included has been selected to improve efficiency, stability, and overall responsiveness without adding unnecessary content or gameplay changes.

Whether you're hosting a server, playing with friends, or building large-scale projects, Quark Optimized helps Minecraft run smoother and more reliably.
